notes: Hezro the Carmelite was one of David's mighty men, known for his valor and military prowess.

name: Hezron
meaning: Son of Perez, grandson of Judah, ancestor of David.
notes: Hezron was the son of Perez and grandson of Judah, and his descendants formed the Hezronite clan within the tribe of Judah.

name: Hezron
meaning: Son of Reuben and grandson of Jacob.
notes: Hezron was a son of Reuben, the firstborn of Jacob, and his descendants formed a clan within the tribe of Reuben.

name: Hiddai
meaning: One of David's mighty men from Gaash.
notes: Hiddai (also called Hurai) from the brooks of Gaash was one of David's mighty men, known for his valor and military prowess.

name: Hiel
meaning: The Bethelite who rebuilt Jericho.
notes: Hiel the Bethelite rebuilt Jericho during the reign of King Ahab, fulfilling Joshua's curse on the city.

name: Hilkiah
meaning: A Levite gatekeeper during David's reign.
notes: Hilkiah was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper in the tabernacle during the reign of King David.

name: Hilkiah
meaning: A Levite descendant of Merari.
notes: Hilkiah was a Levite from the family of Merari, mentioned in the genealogy of the Levites.

name: Hilkiah
meaning: An official during King Hezekiah's reign.
notes: Hilkiah served as a high-ranking official in the court of King Hezekiah of Judah.

name: Hilkiah
meaning: The high priest who discovered the Book of the Law.
notes: Hilkiah, the high priest during King Josiah's reign, discovered the Book of the Law in the temple, sparking a religious reform.

name: Hilkiah
meaning: The father of the prophet Jeremiah.
notes: Hilkiah, a priest from Anathoth, was the father of the prophet Jeremiah.

name: Hilkiah
meaning: A priest who returned from Babylonian exile.
notes: Hilkiah was among the priests who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity and served during the high priesthood of Jeshua and Joiakim.

name: Hilkiah
meaning: A priest who assisted Ezra.
notes: Hilkiah was one of the priests who stood beside Ezra when he read the Book of the Law to the people.

name: Hillel
meaning: Fatther of the judge Abdon
notes: Hillel the Pirathonite, a father of judge Abdon of Israel, led the nation for ten years.

name: Hirah
meaning: Judah's Adullamite friend.
notes: Hirah was an Adullamite who was a close friend of Judah, the son of Jacob.

name: Hiram
meaning: A skilled craftsman from Tyre.
notes: Hiram, a skilled craftsman from Tyre, was commissioned by Solomon to create the bronze furnishings for the temple.

name: Hiram
meaning: King of Tyre, ally of David and Solomon.
notes: Hiram, king of Tyre, provided materials and craftsmen for the construction of David's palace and Solomon's temple and palace.

name: Hivites
meaning: A Canaanite people group.
notes: The Hivites were one of the Canaanite tribes inhabiting the land promised to the Israelites.

name: Hizki
meaning: A Benjamite descendant of Elpaal.
notes: Hizki was a descendant of Elpaal from the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Hizkiah
meaning: A descendant of David through Jeconiah.
notes: Hizkiah was one of the descendants of King David through the line of Jeconiah.

name: Hobab
meaning: Moses' brother-in-law, a Midianite.
notes: Hobab, the son of Jethro (or 'Reuel') the Midianite and Moses' brother-in-law, was invited by Moses to join the Israelites on their journey to the Promised Land.

name: Hod
meaning: A descendant of Asher.
notes: Hod was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

name: Hodaviah
meaning: A descendant of David through Jeconiah.
notes: Hodaviah (also known as Hodaiah) was one of the descendants of King David through the line of Jeconiah.

name: Hodaviah
meaning: A leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
notes: Hodaviah was one of the leaders of the half-tribe of Manasseh during the time of King David.

name: Hodaviah
meaning: A Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem.
notes: Hodaviah was a descendant of Benjamin who resided in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

name: Hodaviah
meaning: A Levite who returned from exile.
notes: Hodaviah (also known as Hodevah or Judah) was a Levite who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity and assisted in rebuilding the temple.

name: Hodesh
meaning: Wife of Shaharaim, a Benjamite
notes: Hodesh was one of the wives of Shaharaim, a Benjamite, and the mother of several of his children.

name: Hodiah
meaning: Wife of a Judahite named Ishbar.
notes: Hodiah was the wife of Ishbar, a descendant of Judah, and the mother two clans.

name: Hodiah
meaning: A leader who signed Nehemiah's covenant.
notes: Hodiah was one of the leaders of the people who signed the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow the Law of God.

name: Hodiah
meaning: A priest who signed Nehemiah's covenant.
notes: Hodiah was one of the priests who signed the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow the Law of God.

name: Hodiah
meaning: A Levite involved in teaching and worship.
notes: Hodiah (also known as Judah) was a Levite who assisted in teaching the Law and leading worship during the time of Ezra and Nehemiah.

name: Hoglah
meaning: Daughter of Zelophehad, of the tribe of Manasseh.
notes: Hoglah was one of the five daughters of Zelophehad who received an inheritance in the Promised Land due to their father's lack of male heirs.

name: Hoham
meaning: King of Hebron, defeated by Joshua.
notes: Hoham, the Amorite king of Hebron, was one of the five kings who formed an alliance against Joshua and the Israelites, but was ultimately defeated.
